LanguageData.PNA_Addiction.label: PNA Addiction
LanguageData.PNA_Addiction.description: Addiction to purple nanofluid keeps sex drive elevated. Addiction gradually fades over time; full recovery takes about 10 days without further exposure. Another dose deepens addiction and relieves withdrawal. Exposure at terminal load deepens existing addiction further. This state belongs to the current body; it does not transfer with a personality or pass to a clone.
LanguageData.PNA_Addiction.stages.1.label: Withdrawal
